items.title: at / in / on — সময় (Time)
items.body:
There are 31 days in May.
Saba will come on Thursday.
We left at 2 o'clock.
I get up at dawn; I walk in the morning.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সময়, স্থান ও অবস্থান (Time • Place • Position)

items.title: at / in / on — স্থান (Place)
items.body:
Animals live on earth.
We live in Bangladesh.
I left my mobile at home.
The boy sat on a stone.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সময়, স্থান ও অবস্থান (Time • Place • Position)

items.title: since / for / by / till — সময়ের ব্যাপ্তি ও সীমা
items.body:
He has been ill for four days since Friday last.
I shall come back by/before the seven of this month.
I'm going away for a few days.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সময়, স্থান ও অবস্থান (Time • Place • Position)

items.title: to / into / through / out of — গতি ও দিক (Motion)
items.body:
Shobha came into the room.
Water changes into vapour.
The ball went out of the playground.
The old man sailed away to the south.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সময়, স্থান ও অবস্থান (Time • Place • Position)

items.title: অবস্থান ও দিকের Preposition (under, over, around, behind, beyond…)
items.body:
The ball is under the table.
The bird flew over the house.
I walked along the river side.
The cloud is above us.
Put the book on the table (touching) — over (not touching).
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সময়, স্থান ও অবস্থান (Time • Place • Position)

items.title: by / with — কর্তা ও যন্ত্র (Agent • Instrument • Means)
items.body:
The snake was killed by the boy with a stick.
May I pay by cheque?
We stayed with a smile.
Success comes by hard work.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: between / among
items.body:
Distribute the fruits between Rahim and Karim.
Distribute the fruits among the four brothers.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: of — উপকরণ, মালিকানা, উৎস, অংশ
items.body:
This is a dress of blue silk.
The sails of their ship opened wide.
The hands of the butcher.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: from — উৎস, শুরু ও পৃথকীকরণ
items.body:
He borrowed a book from his friend.
The apple fell from the tree.
light coming from the sun.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: for — জন্য, উদ্দেশ্য ও কারণ
items.body:
There is a letter for you.
He is learning English for his work.
I bought this book for 20 taka.
Yangoon is famous for its pagodas.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: about / on — বিষয় (Topic)
items.body:
He knows nothing about this matter.
Das Capital is a book on social science.
She delivered a speech on education.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — সম্পর্ক ও অর্থ-ভিত্তিক Preposition (by, with, of, from, for, about…)

items.title: Verb + Preposition (বিশেষ Verb-এর পরের Preposition)
items.body:
depend on
abide by
suffer from
hanker after
look down upon
break down
give up.
items.topic: পর্ব ৩ — Appropriate Prepositions (Verb • Adjective • Noun-এর পরে)

items.title: Adjective / Participle + Preposition
items.body:
accustomed to
proud of
fond of
different from
responsible for
good at
interested in.
items.topic: পর্ব ৩ — Appropriate Prepositions (Verb • Adjective • Noun-এর পরে)

items.title: Noun + Preposition
items.body:
thirst for knowledge
emphasis on
lack of
access to
relief from
role in.
items.topic: পর্ব ৩ — Appropriate Prepositions (Verb • Adjective • Noun-এর পরে)

items.title: Phrasal / Compound Preposition
items.body:
Owing to his illness, he could not finish the work.
He acted according to my instructions.
In order to avoid litigation, he accepted taka 300.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — Phrasal, Special ও Fixed Expression

items.title: অন্য Part of Speech Preposition-এর মতো (without, like, besides, until…)
items.body:
None but the virtuous are blessed.
He is older than her.
Despite his willingness, he could not attend.
We cannot survive without it.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — Phrasal, Special ও Fixed Expression

items.title: Fixed Expression (Idiom) ও to-Infinitive
items.body:
Their sacrifice will end in vain.
In this regard, strict rules must be introduced.
One of our senior teachers read out the report.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — Phrasal, Special ও Fixed Expression
